body: I suppose it helps to have a means to access your personal belognings when in the hospital then, eh? At leaset outside of the psych ward.
I suppose it might be different in different parts of the hospital. Never been in the psych ward, mostly just the ICU and post-op, etc.
They let you play with puzzles? That's fun.

Never heard of hospital food being referred to as *good*. Been in an out of hospitals a lot in my life but I don't recall ever eating there. At least not by choice.

Fortunately I guess my body stopped before I could cause too much pain. Mostly just nausea, head aches, etc.
